unsupported: Maine Wood Concepts operates from New Vineyard, a rural community in Franklin County, Maine, where it produces turned and custom wood components for industrial customers.
The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.
The shop specializes in wood turning and the manufacture of custom wood components, delivering finished wood parts and shapes to downstream assemblers.
Its capabilities center on shaping raw lumber into precision-turned blanks, profiles, and complex geometries that feed directly into furniture and cabinet production lines.
These clients rely on the company for consistent quality in species selection, dimensional accuracy, and surface preparation.
The company has not publicly stated a specific founding mission or competitive differentiation beyond its focus on turned and custom wood parts.
